amendment.title: Validation-gated consolidation and task grouping
amendment.timing: post hoc: proposed after all tier-1, tier-2 and A1 results were known; specified and frozen before any gated, grouping, fallback, oracle or detection statistic was computed
amendment.fits: none: reuses the stored inner-validation errors and outer-test errors of existing fits
amendment.status: amendment on existing fits; descriptive, no p-values

tier1.validation_error: inner-validation MAE in training-scaled units at the selected context L, mean over leads, per resource; seed-specific

tier2.validation_error: inner-validation MSE in training-scaled units at the epoch selected for the final refit, pooled over the five horizons, per resource; seed-specific
tier2.persistence_validation_error: the same MSE for the last scaled value of the resource's own input channel, on the same inner-validation windows (seed independent)
tier2.published_contrasts: results.P4.contrasts of analysis_v04.json; fixed-policy median ratios must match exactly

policies.fixed: S1, S2, M0 (tier 2, where defined) and M1 applied to every unit
policies.G-ctx: per unit and resource, S2 if its validation error is strictly lower than S1's, else S1 (where S1 is defined)
policies.G-share: per unit, M1 if the mean over resources of the validation-error ratio M1/S2 is at most 1 + tolerance, else S2 (primary)
policies.G-full: per unit, independent baseline I = G-ctx (S2 where S1 is undefined); shared candidate = M1 or M0 (where defined) with the lower mean validation ratio against I; consolidate if that ratio is at most 1 + tolerance, else I
policies.G-group: tier-2 LSTM only: among the 15 partitions of the four resources into all-input models (singletons are S2, pairs and triples are the stored lattice models, the full set is M1), the feasible partitions have mean validation ratio against S2 at most 1 + tolerance; choose the one with fewest models, ties broken by the lower mean ratio and then by the fixed partition order
policies.fallback: tier 2 only: after S2, G-share or G-group at the primary tolerance, replace a resource's model by persistence where persistence's validation error is strictly lower; a persistence target uses no model
policies.oracle: descriptive upper bound, not a policy: per unit, the candidate of G-share (M1 or S2) or of G-group (one of the 15 partitions) with the lowest outer score, the mean over resources of the seed-specific horizon-mean outer MAE ratio against S2; never enters a verdict

unit: block x entity x fold x seed; every policy decision uses only that unit's inner-validation errors

outcomes.accuracy: per policy x block x resource (x backbone): matched-cell median MAE ratio and win rate against S2 and against M1, over seed-averaged entity x fold x horizon cells; MacroMAE gain against S2
outcomes.savings: mean models per unit; savings retained R = (models(S2) - models(policy)) / (models(S2) - models(M1)), pooled over units; tier 2 also mean parameters relative to S2
outcomes.intervals: VM-cluster percentile 95% bootstrap, seed 20261007, 10,000 replicates; tier 2 reuses the frozen tier-2 draw matrices; tier 1 draws one matrix per block in the order TimeTrack, fastStorage, Rnd, Materna-T1, Materna-T2, Materna-T3 from one generator

H-A3a.frames: tier 1: six blocks x four resources (24 cells); tier 2: four backbones x two blocks x four resources (32 cells); judged per tier
H-A3a.cost_cell: a cell whose policy:S2 matched-cell median ratio exceeds 1.01
H-A3a.reference_cost_cells: the number of cells whose M1:S2 median ratio exceeds 1.01 (expected 22 in tier 1 and 13 in tier 2; recomputed and checked)
H-A3a.cost_ok: cost cells at most floor(reference cost cells / 2)
verdicts: keeps most savings at reduced cost
keeps some savings at reduced cost

H-A3b.statistic: Spearman rho, per frame (tier-1 block; tier-2 backbone x block), between the unit-level validation score (mean over resources of the validation ratio M1/S2) and the unit-level outer score (mean over resources and horizons of the seed-specific outer MAE ratio M1/S2), with a VM-cluster bootstrap interval
H-A3b.also_reported: balanced accuracy of the sign of the validation score for the sign of the outer score, per frame

H-A3c.policy: G-group against G-share, both at the primary tolerance, tier-2 LSTM (8 cells)
verdicts: mean models(G-group) <= mean models(G-share) - 0.25 and cost cells(G-group) <= cost cells(G-share) + 1

fallback.statistic: persistence skill (paper definition) of S2 + fallback in the 16 tier-2 CPU and throughput cells (4 backbones x 2 resources x 2 blocks)
verdicts: at least 8 of 16 cells have positive skill
fallback does not restore positive skill

reproduction_guards: tier-1 fixed S2 and M1 seed means reproduce the published matched cells within the relative tolerance
tier-2 fixed-policy median ratios for S2:S1, M1:M0, M0:S1 and M1:S2 equal analysis_v04.json exactly
every tier-2 final fit links to its inner fit, whose selected epoch has a validation error for every task; every tier-1 final run has seed-matched inner rows at its selected context
tier-2 persistence validation windows match the inner-validation split hash and scaler recorded by the inner fits
